purpose: Complete the local linear-lift classification for the exact bounded-occurrence witness carrier. v2.8 proves that one 2D subspace per occurrence cannot be exact. This artifact gives an explicit one-3D-subspace-per-occurrence representation whose direct-sum selections are exactly the legal conflict-free witness sets.

construction.ground: One literal occurrence o per clause position of the normalized 2/3-CNF.
construction.forbidden_pairs: Two occurrences conflict iff they lie in the same clause or are opposite-sign occurrences of the same original Boolean variable.
ambient_basis: For every clause C create one basis token c_C.
For every sign-conflict edge e={o,o'} create one basis token s_e.
For every occurrence o create enough private basis tokens p_{o,j} to bring its block dimension to exactly three.
construction.occurrence_block: S_o is the span of c_{C(o)}, all sign tokens s_e incident to o, and its private padding tokens. Under occurrence degree <=3, an occurrence has at most two opposite-sign conflict neighbors, so before padding this uses at most three independent basis tokens.
construction.size: There are O(q) clause/sign/private tokens and q occurrence blocks, so the represented matrix has polynomial dimensions and a sparse 0/1 description.

theorem.name: LEGAL_WITNESS_SETS_IFF_DIRECT_SUMS_OF_3D_OCCURRENCE_BLOCKS
theorem.statement: For every set X of literal occurrences, dim(sum_{o in X} S_o)=3|X| iff X contains no forbidden pair. Consequently, for a normalized formula with m clauses, F is satisfiable iff there exist m occurrence blocks whose sum has dimension 3m.
proof: If X contains a same-clause pair, both blocks contain c_C; if it contains an opposite-sign pair, both blocks contain their common s_e. In either case the selected blocks are not a direct sum.

Conversely, if X contains no forbidden pair, no two selected blocks share any clause token or sign-conflict token. Private padding tokens are unique by construction. Hence the basis supports of all selected S_o are pairwise disjoint, so their sum is direct and has dimension 3|X|.

A direct-sum selection of m blocks cannot contain two occurrences from one clause. There are exactly m clauses, so it chooses exactly one occurrence from every clause. It also contains no opposite-sign pair. Thus it is exactly a sign-consistent one-witness-per-clause set and reconstructs a satisfying assignment.
A satisfying assignment supplies one true occurrence witness per clause; these are sign-consistent, hence conflict-free, and their blocks form a direct sum of dimension 3m.

minimality.upper_bound: Three dimensions per occurrence suffice by the explicit construction above.
minimality.lower_bound_scope: In the natural one-fixed-subspace-per-occurrence direct-sum model with 2D blocks, v2.8 proves impossibility already on one mixed degree-3 P3 switch plus the minority clause alternative.
minimality.conclusion: Within the one-block-per-occurrence direct-sum model, local dimension 3 is the first possible exact dimension.

structure.clause_coordinate: Every block has exactly one clause token.
structure.sign_coordinates: Every block has at most two sign-conflict tokens; the sign-token incidence graph is a disjoint union of P3/K2 components inherited from v2.4.
structure.private_coordinates: Padding coordinates occur in exactly one block and are algorithmically inert except for fixing block dimension.
structure.hard_core: After deleting private coordinates, each block is clause-token + <=2 P3/K2 sign tokens. This is much narrower than arbitrary 3-dimensional linear matroid matching.

algorithmic_consequence.positive: The exact SAT residual has a polynomial-size linear representation with block dimension exactly three and extremely sparse support.
algorithmic_consequence.not_a_solver: Generic selection of disjoint/independent 3-element linear blocks is not supplied as a polynomial subroutine. This artifact is a representation theorem, not a P=NP proof.
algorithmic_consequence.live_attack: Exploit the clause+P3/K2 token geometry to construct a nonlocal reduction from these special 3D blocks to a polynomially solvable 2D matroid-parity/Pfaffian object, or derive a direct augmentation theorem on the 3D blocks.

next_target.name: E8_SPARSE_3D_TO_2D_GLOBAL_CONTRACTION_OR_AUGMENTATION_V3_0
next_target.directive: Use that every nonprivate 3D block consists of one clause coordinate plus at most two sign coordinates whose incidence graph is P3/K2. A successful transformation must preserve the legal L,R,N configuration that killed local 2D lifts, so any dimension reduction must be genuinely global/nonlocal rather than blockwise.
success_obligations: no exponential branching, subset expansion, field degree, or coefficient bitlength
